reason: TUBE STRIKE: Piccadilly line service control staff are taking strike action from Friday 20 until Saturday evening, 21 November. Due to shared infrastructure around the Ealing Common District line depot, there will be no DISTRICT LINE service between Turnham Green and Ealing Broadway from midday on Friday until Saturday evening, with a reduced service on the rest of the line. No Piccadilly line service is expected during the strike. Replacement bus services operate during Friday Night Tube and Saturday daytime hours only. Please use MILDMAY LINE services between Gunnersbury, Kew Gardens and Richmond, where available.
